protocol.hit_verification: torch.profiler CUDA kernel-name capture on representative calls, outside timed regions
protocol.memory: baseline recorded before timed window; peak within window (includes compile+warmup); delta is a lower bound under shared process residency
protocol.p95: quantile estimate of per-block mean per-iter time (5 blocks), not per-request tail latency
protocol.throughput: calls_per_s = 1000 / ms_per_iter_median; samples_per_s = batch * calls_per_s (model cases only)
protocol.zero_restore: per-block restore timed as separate case

modelB/default/fwd.block_mean_p95_note: quantile estimate of per-block mean per-iter time over 5 blocks; not a per-request tail latency

first_call.note: includes JIT/autotune; cache state = cold-process (per-family process)

modelB/default/fwd.mem_window: first-call compile + warmup + timed blocks; delta is a lower bound (case inputs coexist in the process)
modelB/default/fwd.timing: cuda events device time + synced wall clock
